notes.title: Prototype Edition changes
notes.content:
Greetings, we saw your reviews, comments, videos. And so we have some information.

As you might saw, we changed the name from "Office No.41" to "Office No.41: Prototype Edition". Let us explain. Due to the fact that this version of first act could be a lot better, and some people didn't quite understand that it includes only act 1, we changed the name to "Prototype Edition".

[b]So, now what?[/b]

You can still buy a prototype version and play it! Also, if you do this, you will recieve a free "remade" act 1 that will be in the full game!

In the meantime, we are currently working on the act 1 "remake" and act 2! We also listened to your reviews and will try to make the new act 1 and subsequent acts so that you like them!

[b]And last thing. Ask us anything you like in the comments below this post, we will try to answer every question![/b]

notes.title: First Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we heard your feedbacks about the game and we will continue making it better!

Fixes and changes in this patch:

-Added Russian subtitles
-Added background buildings
-Removed an invisible wall to the left entrance in [b]School Backyard[/b]
-Fixed diary and note texts
-Fixed bug with getting stuck at the front doors
-Minor fixes
